name: Cerave Hyaluronic Acid Serum for Face with Vitamin B5 and Ceramides
description: A lightweight hydrating serum with up to 24-hour hydration, formulated with 3 Essential Ceramides, Vitamin B5 and Hyaluronic Acid. Developed with Dermatologists, this hyaluronic acid gel serum formula helps to protect the natural skin barrier and retain skin moisture.
